about.title: About the maker
about.portraitAlt: Julija on a bench against a deep red wall, in a black leather jacket
about.body:
Every person is unlike any other — and I would like a piece of jewellery to underline that and complete the image. All my work is made by hand and exists in a single copy; I make each piece with great love and with attention to the person it is for.

Often a piece is born on its own — out of something I saw in nature or in the people around me: the way waves spread across the sea, the way a flower opens, the way a branch grows, the way a fold falls, the way a stone holds its colour. Such a piece waits for a while, and one day it finds its person — the one who finds their own meaning in it.

I take commissions as well. We usually talk them through in person, often with fittings — that is how I hear someone and understand what they truly want. But this is handwork, and it begins with a piece of silver: exactly how it will turn out, no one can know in advance. The metal always adds something of its own.

Alongside jewellery I create art pieces. They can be bought as well — in a room such a piece becomes its luxury, the thing the space gathers around.

My philosophy of life is set into every piece. I cannot put it into words — but I can put it into the work.

My first degree is in law, a master’s, followed by years in management. For five years I have been studying the craft at Oleg Auzer’s jewellery school in Limbaži, in the building of the Museum of Living Silver — and that is where I make my work. For eight years I have been studying psychology and philosophy — they help me look from a different angle and notice what I used to walk past. I live in Riga.

The road here was not an easy one — from business into art. But now I know for certain: this is my path, and I am doing what I am meant to do.

Everything I manage to make I owe to my teachers and mentors. My work is my lasting gratitude to them.

steps.title: Idea and sketch
steps.text: Every piece starts on paper — proportion, weight and the way it will sit on the body.

steps.title: Metal
steps.text: Sterling silver and gold, worked by hand: sawing, forging, soldering, filing.

steps.title: Stone
steps.text: Stones are chosen one by one and set to suit the character of the metal.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Polishing, patina and a final check — each piece exists in a single copy.
